phases.label: 制定方案
phases.note: 2/16 个镜头要改，2 张关键画面

plan.subject: An anthropomorphic Shiba Inu warrior with a realistic orange-tan dog head, upright triangular ears, cream cheeks and muzzle, dark eyes, and a black nose; an athletic humanoid body wearing olive-green segmented armor with a subtle hexagonal texture over a black and purple undersuit, a silver winged chest emblem, silver forearm guards, green gloves, a green utility belt, armored boots, and a circular silver upper-back module flanked by silver wings.
plan.target: The humanoid armored knight appearing at the stage entrance and on the concert runway, wearing dark metallic silver and black pointed plate armor, a fully enclosed horned helmet, oversized angular shoulder plates, claw-like gauntlets, armored greaves, and red illuminated accents.
plan.keep: Preserve all other performers and their faces, clothing and accessories, all crew and spectators, microphones, stage equipment, locations, backgrounds, lighting, camera positions and movements, framing, choreography, cuts, timing, and narrative.
plan.change: Replace only the armored knight with the reference Shiba Inu warrior, including its exposed canine head and complete green, black, purple, and silver armor, while matching the original performer's placement, scale, movements, and interactions.
plan.summary: 将原片两处黑银色角盔战士替换为用户图中的柴犬机甲战士，保留其他人物及全部场景、动作、运镜和剪辑节奏。

variants.label: 橄榄绿柴犬机甲
variants.desc: Olive green, black, purple, silver, orange-tan, and cream.

scenes.edit: Replace the knight at the stage entrance with the reference Shiba Inu warrior in the same front three-quarter framing and overhead arm pose; clearly establish the exposed canine face, green shoulder and chest armor, silver winged chest emblem, purple undersuit panels, and armored gloves, preserving the microphone, stage equipment, daylight backlight, and red stage reflections.

Replace the rear-facing knight on the concert runway with the reference Shiba Inu warrior, clearly showing the orange-tan back of its head, upright ears, green back armor, silver circular winged back module, purple undersuit panels, utility belt, and armored boots; preserve the alternating raised-knee steps, hand positions, runway perspective, crowd phone lights, and dusk backlight.
